Mischievous Whimsicott? Not on Mabosstiff’s Watch! | POKÉTOON Short
Mabosstiff is a kind-hearted, family-loving Pokémon, so its Trainer trusts it to watch over her sleeping baby while she’s busy. But when a Whimsicott floats through the window on a passing breeze, it brings mischief and an abundance of fluffy puffs of cotton!
Let’s hope all that mayhem doesn’t wake the baby!
